content: Melvin-Koushki lists two works as organized according to an epistemological hierarchy, examining a topic from the standpoint of groups such as traditionists, philosophers, Sufis and lettrists in ascending order: the R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat (dated 'before 829/1426') and the R. Madārij Afhām al-Afwāj (Mazandaran, 831/1428). He says the hierarchy is laid out most clearly in the R. Shaqq-i Qamar.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
